summary.ja: 1st EP『New Jeans』の1曲目を飾るデビュー曲。MVは事前告知なしに7月22日に先行公開された。
summary.en: Debut track that opens the 1st EP New Jeans; its music video dropped on 22 July with no prior announcement.

editor_note: MV/video premiered 2022-07-22 KST; full digital download/streaming started 2022-08-01 with the EP. | Tag 'ep-new-jeans' removed from reader-facing tags: the EP title was not public until the 2022-07-25 pre-order. | moved from 2022-07-22 (MV premiere) to streaming release 2022-08-01: Moved from 2022-07-22. 07-22 00:00 KST was the surprise MV premiere only (isplus/newsis). Audio was NOT on streaming that day: Apple Music KR datePublished 2022-08-01 and Melon album 11011565 date 2022.08.01; EP went live 18:00 KST Aug 1 (isplus 2022-08-04). The Spotify "Attention" entry dated 2022-07-22 (album 0gtYJ4BxqMs2xYXVQjn14J) is a music-video entry, not audio. | Credits from en.wikipedia Attention_(NewJeans_song) and New_Jeans_(EP); distributor from namu.wiki New Jeans(음반).
note_en: The MV was released early, on July 22.

detail.ja: 1st EP『New Jeans』の1曲目に収録されたデビュー曲で、8月1日18時にEPと同時に配信が始まった。収録時間は3分00秒。作詞はGigi、Duckbay、ダニエル、作曲は250とDuckbay、編曲とプロデュースは250。ボーカルディレクションはJungwoo Jang、ミックスはTony MaseratiとDavid K. Younghyun、録音はHYBE Studio。ミュージックビデオは7月22日0時に事前告知なしで公開されており、レーベルはADOR、流通はYG PLUS。
detail.en: Debut track and track 1 of the 1st EP New Jeans, released for download and streaming at 18:00 KST on 1 August together with the EP. Running time 3:00. Lyrics by Gigi, Duckbay and Danielle; music by 250 and Duckbay; arranged and produced by 250. Vocal direction by Jungwoo Jang, mixing by Tony Maserati and David K. Younghyun, recorded at HYBE Studio. The music video had premiered without announcement on 22 July at 00:00 KST. Released by ADOR, distributed by YG PLUS.

summary.ja: デビューEPの3つのタイトル曲のうち最後に公開された曲。MVはカウントダウンライブの最中に初公開された。
summary.en: The last of the debut EP's three title tracks to be unveiled; its music video premiered in the middle of the countdown live.

editor_note: Confirmed: released with the EP 2022-08-01 18:00 KST (Apple Music KR datePublished 2022-08-01; Melon 2022.08.01; isplus "1일 오후 6시"). Cookie MV also dropped Aug 1. | Credits from en.wikipedia Cookie_(NewJeans_song) and namu.wiki Cookie(NewJeans); MV director from YouTube description.

detail.ja: 1st EP『New Jeans』の3曲目で、3つのタイトル曲のうち最後に公開された。EPとともに18時に配信が始まり、同時刻のカウントダウンライブ中にDongle Shin監督のミュージックビデオが公開された。収録時間は3分55秒。作詞はGigiとYlva Dimberg、作曲はPark Jin-su（FRNK）とYlva Dimberg、編曲とプロデュースはPark Jin-su。レーベルはADOR、流通はYG PLUS。
detail.en: Track 3 of the 1st EP New Jeans and the last of its three title tracks to be unveiled. Streaming began at 18:00 KST with the EP, and the music video, directed by Dongle Shin, premiered during the countdown live held at the same hour. Running time 3:55. Lyrics by Gigi and Ylva Dimberg; music by Park Jin-su (FRNK) and Ylva Dimberg; arranged and produced by Park Jin-su. Released by ADOR, distributed by YG PLUS.

summary.ja: デビューEPの2番目のタイトル曲。イントロ映像とメンバー別4バージョンのMVが7月23日に先行公開された。
summary.en: Second title track of the debut EP; an intro clip and four member-focused music videos had arrived on 23 July.

editor_note: Unveiled via MV 2022-07-23; digital streaming started 2022-08-01 with the EP. | Tag 'ep-new-jeans' removed from reader-facing tags: the EP title was not public until the 2022-07-25 pre-order. | moved from 2022-07-23 (MV premiere) to streaming release 2022-08-01: Moved from 2022-07-23. 07-23 was the MV unveiling (4 versions) only; audio streaming started 2022-08-01 18:00 KST with the EP (Apple Music KR datePublished 2022-08-01; Melon 2022.08.01). | Credits from en.wikipedia Hype_Boy and New_Jeans_(EP). Summary's 'five MV versions' counts the intro clip plus four member versions.
note_en: The MV was released early, on July 23.

detail.ja: 1st EP『New Jeans』の2曲目にして2番目のタイトル曲で、EPとともに18時に配信された。収録時間は2分59秒で、作詞はGigi、Ylva Dimberg、ハニ、作曲は250とYlva Dimberg、編曲とプロデュースは250。ミュージックビデオは7月23日にイントロ映像とメンバー別4バージョン（MINJI、HANNI、DANIELLE&HAERIN、HYEIN）が公開されており、どのバージョンもメンバーがプールパーティーに相手を招くという設定を共有する。レーベルはADOR、流通はYG PLUS。
detail.en: Track 2 and second title track of the 1st EP New Jeans, released for streaming at 18:00 KST with the EP. Running time 2:59; lyrics by Gigi, Ylva Dimberg and Hanni, music by 250 and Ylva Dimberg, arranged and produced by 250. On 23 July an intro clip and four member-focused music videos (MINJI, HANNI, DANIELLE&HAERIN, HYEIN) had been released, all sharing a premise in which the members invite a boy to a pool party. Released by ADOR, distributed by YG PLUS.

summary.ja: 「Attention」「Hype Boy」「Cookie」「Hurt」の4曲を収めたデビューEP。配信は8月1日、CDは8月8日発売。
summary.en: Debut EP with four tracks, 'Attention', 'Hype Boy', 'Cookie' and 'Hurt'; digital on 1 August, CD on 8 August.

editor_note: Physical CD (Bag ver./Weverse Album ver.) released 2022-08-08. US physical release via Geffen 2023-03-23. | Confirmed: digital release 2022-08-01 18:00 KST (Apple Music KR datePublished 2022-08-01; Melon album 2022.08.01; isplus). CD 2022-08-08. | Tracklist and per-track credits from en.wikipedia New_Jeans_(EP); editions, distributor and choreography credit from namu.wiki New Jeans(음반). Total length given variously as 12:52 (Wikipedia tracklist) and 12:48 (namu). / Cut for length: choreography/performance credit (Kim Eun-ju, Black Q) and label/distributor (ADOR / YG PLUS) — retained in credits.

detail.ja: デビューEPで、18時に配信が始まり、CDは8月8日に発売された。収録曲は「Attention」（3:00）、「Hype Boy」（2:59）、「Cookie」（3:55）、「Hurt」（2:57）の4曲で、「Hurt」は作詞Gigi・Amanda Lundstedt、作曲250・Amanda Lundstedt、編曲250。総括プロデューサーはMin Hee-jin、メインプロデューサーは250とPark Jin-su（FRNK）。7月25日にBluebook ver.、Weverse Albums ver.、限定のBag ver.の3形態が告知され、予約販売が始まった。
detail.en: Debut EP, streaming from 18:00 KST with the CD following on 8 August. Four tracks: 'Attention' (3:00), 'Hype Boy' (2:59), 'Cookie' (3:55) and 'Hurt' (2:57); 'Hurt' is written by Gigi and Amanda Lundstedt, composed by 250 and Amanda Lundstedt and arranged by 250. Executive producer Min Hee-jin; main producers 250 and Park Jin-su (FRNK). Three physical editions, Bluebook ver., Weverse Albums ver. and a limited Bag ver., were announced on 25 July as pre-orders opened.

credits.label: ADOR
credits.editions: Bluebook ver., Weverse Albums ver., Bag ver. (limited)

summary.ja: シングル1集『OMG』の先行公開曲。ボルチモア・クラブのリズムを基調とし、MVはside A／side Bの2本立て。
summary.en: Pre-release track from the single album OMG, built on a Baltimore club rhythm and paired with a two-part (side A / side B) music video.

editor_note: Confirmed: Apple Music KR "Ditto - Single" datePublished 2022-12-19; released 18:00 KST (iMBC/Elle). On Melon it sits inside the OMG album (albumId 11127145). | Credits from en.wikipedia Ditto_(NewJeans_song) and OMG_(NewJeans_album); length discrepancy (3:05 Korean sites vs 3:07) per namu.wiki. / Cut for length: full writer list (lyrics Ylva Dimberg, The Black Skirts/Jo Hyu-il, Oohyo, Minji; music 250, Ylva Dimberg) — retained in credits.

detail.ja: シングル1集『OMG』の先行公開曲で、18時に配信された。収録時間は3分05秒（フル版は3分07秒）で、作詞にはミンジが加わり、編曲とプロデュースは250。ボルチモア・クラブのリズムを基調に、コーラスパッドとオールドスクールのドラムブレイクを組み合わせた曲で、同時公開のミュージックビデオ（side A／side B）はShin Woo-seok（Dolphiners Films）が監督した。シングル『OMG』は11月10日のHYBE説明会で1月2日発売が予告され、12月12日からティザーが公開、12月14日に予約販売が始まっていた。
detail.en: Pre-release track from the 1st single album OMG, released at 18:00 KST. Running time 3:05 (3:07 in the full version); Minji is among the lyricists, and 250 arranged and produced. The song rides a Baltimore club rhythm, pairing a choir pad with an old-school drum break, and the music video released alongside it, in side A and side B, was directed by Shin Woo-seok of Dolphiners Films. The single album had been announced for 2 January at HYBE's briefing on 10 November; teasers began on 12 December and pre-orders opened on 14 December.

credits.lyricist: Ylva Dimberg, The Black Skirts, Oohyo, Minji
credits.label: ADOR

summary.ja: シングル1集のタイトル曲。UKガラージとトラップを取り入れたヒップホップ／R&Bで、MVは精神科病院が舞台。
summary.en: Title track of the 1st single album: hip-hop and R&B with UK garage and trap touches, with a music video set in a psychiatric hospital.

editor_note: Confirmed: Apple Music KR datePublished 2023-01-02; Melon 2023.01.02; released 18:00 KST (imaeil). | Credits from en.wikipedia OMG_(NewJeans_song); MV runtime 6:34 from YouTube listing. / Cut for length: full writer list (lyrics Gigi, Ylva Dimberg, Hanni; music Park Jin-su/FRNK, Ylva Dimberg, David Dawood) — retained in credits.

detail.ja: シングル1集『OMG』のタイトル曲で、18時に配信された。収録時間は3分32秒で、作詞にはハニが加わり、編曲とプロデュースはPark Jin-su（FRNK）、録音はHYBE Studio。ADORはUKガラージとトラップの要素を取り入れたヒップホップ／R&B曲と説明した。同時公開のミュージックビデオ（約6分34秒）はShin Woo-seok（Dolphiners Films）が監督し、精神科病院を舞台にメンバーが各々の妄想を語る構成で、俳優Kim Joo-hunがカメオ出演した。発売1時間前の17時にはYouTubeとWeverseでカウントダウンライブが配信された。
detail.en: Title track of the 1st single album OMG, released at 18:00 KST. Running time 3:32; Hanni is among the lyricists, Park Jin-su (FRNK) arranged and produced, and it was recorded at HYBE Studio. ADOR described it as a hip-hop and R&B song with UK garage and trap elements. The music video released at the same time (about 6:34), directed by Shin Woo-seok of Dolphiners Films, is set in a psychiatric hospital where each member narrates her own delusion, with actor Kim Joo-hun in a cameo. A countdown live streamed on YouTube and Weverse at 17:00, an hour before release.

credits.composer: Park Jin-su (FRNK), Ylva Dimberg, David Dawood
credits.label: ADOR

summary.ja: タイトル曲「OMG」と先行公開曲「Ditto」の2曲を収めたシングル1集。Message Card ver.とWeverse Albums ver.の2形態。
summary.en: First single album pairing the title track 'OMG' with the pre-released 'Ditto', issued in Message Card and Weverse Albums editions.

editor_note: Confirmed: Apple Music KR datePublished 2023-01-02; Melon album 11127145 date 2023.01.02; 18:00 KST. | From en.wikipedia OMG_(NewJeans_album), namu.wiki OMG(NewJeans) and Soompi update log (pre-order 12/14, packshot 12/20).

detail.ja: シングル1集で、18時に配信が始まった。収録曲はタイトル曲「OMG」（3:32）と12月19日に先行公開された「Ditto」（3:06）の2曲で、総収録時間は約6分38秒。総括プロデューサーはMin Hee-jin、プロデューサーは250とPark Jin-su（FRNK）、録音はソウル・龍山のHYBE Studio。フィジカルはMessage Card ver.とWeverse Albums ver.の2形態で、予約販売は12月14日に始まり、パックショットは12月20日に公開された。発売は2022年11月10日のHYBE説明会で予告されており、レーベルはADOR、流通はYG PLUS。
detail.en: 1st single album, streaming from 18:00 KST. Two tracks, the title track 'OMG' (3:32) and 'Ditto' (3:06), pre-released on 19 December, for about 6:38 in total. Executive producer Min Hee-jin; producers 250 and Park Jin-su (FRNK); recorded at HYBE Studio in Yongsan, Seoul. Two physical editions, Message Card ver. and Weverse Albums ver.; pre-orders opened on 14 December and the packshot was revealed on 20 December. The release had been announced at HYBE's briefing on 10 November 2022. Released by ADOR, distributed by YG PLUS.

credits.label: ADOR
credits.editions: Message Card ver., Weverse Albums ver.

title.ja: Zero（コカ・コーラ ゼロ キャンペーンソング）

summary.ja: コカ・コーラ ゼロシュガー（韓国）のキャンペーンソング。歌詞の大半が英語で、グループ初の英語主体の曲になった。
summary.en: Campaign song for Coca-Cola Zero Sugar in Korea and the group's first track sung mostly in English, released with a music video.

editor_note: Confirmed: Apple Music KR datePublished 2023-04-03; Melon 2023.04.03; song + MV dropped 18:00 KST per ADOR (Soompi). | Songwriting split per en.wikipedia Zero_(NewJeans_song) (namu.wiki lists lyrics/music the other way round); executive producers per namu.wiki.

detail.ja: コカ・コーラ ゼロシュガー（韓国）のキャンペーンソングとして18時に配信されたプロモーションシングル。収録時間は2分34秒で、作曲はMonroとYlva Dimberg、作詞はGigiとYlva Dimberg、編曲とプロデュースはMonro。歌詞の大半が英語で、グループとして初めて英語を主体とした曲になった。同時刻にNewJeans公式YouTubeチャンネルで公開されたミュージックビデオは、メンバーが支度をし、振付を披露し、コカ・コーラを飲む場面で構成され、15秒・30秒のTVCMも制作された。レーベルはADOR、流通はYG PLUS。
detail.en: Promotional single released at 18:00 KST as the campaign song for Coca-Cola Zero Sugar in Korea. Running time 2:34; music by Monro and Ylva Dimberg, lyrics by Gigi and Ylva Dimberg, arranged and produced by Monro. Sung mostly in English, it was the group's first track primarily in that language. The music video, premiered on the NewJeans YouTube channel at the same hour, shows the members getting ready, dancing the choreography and drinking Coca-Cola; 15- and 30-second TV commercials were also made. Released by ADOR, distributed by YG PLUS.

title.ja: 저곳으로（『リトル・マーメイド』韓国語版OST）- ダニエル
title.en: Part of Your World (Korean ver., The Little Mermaid OST) - Danielle

summary.ja: 『リトル・マーメイド』韓国語吹替版でアリエル役を務めたダニエルが歌う「Part of Your World」の韓国語版。
summary.en: Danielle, who voices Ariel in the Korean dub of The Little Mermaid, sings the Korean version of 'Part of Your World'.

editor_note: Generasia lists 2023-05-16; Korea JoongAng Daily/Wikipedia give 2023-05-17 (Wednesday). Using 05-17. | Confirmed 2023-05-17 (resolves Generasia 05-16): Apple Music KR "저곳으로 (인어공주) - Single" datePublished 2023-05-17; Melon album 11245115 date 2023.05.17; released 18:00 KST (iMBC 2023-05-17). | Release time and channel from iMBC enews 382330; Korean lyric translator not sourced.

detail.ja: ディズニー実写映画『リトル・マーメイド』（韓国公開5月24日）の韓国語吹替版でアリエル役を務めたダニエルが歌う、「Part of Your World」の韓国語版。18時に各音源サイトで発売され、同時にミュージックビデオがDisney Music Korea VEVOのYouTubeチャンネルで公開された。原曲の作曲はAlan Menken、作詞はHoward Ashman。5月12日に公開されたミュージックビデオのティザーは、韓国のYouTube急上昇1位に入っていた。
detail.en: Korean-language version of 'Part of Your World' sung by Danielle, who voices Ariel in the Korean dub of Disney's live-action The Little Mermaid (in Korean cinemas from 24 May). It went on sale on Korean music sites at 18:00 KST, with the music video premiering at the same time on the Disney Music Korea VEVO YouTube channel. The original was composed by Alan Menken with lyrics by Howard Ashman. A teaser for the video, posted on 12 May, had reached number one on YouTube Korea's trending list.

title.ja: 『リトル・マーメイド』韓国語版サウンドトラック（ダニエル参加）
title.en: The Little Mermaid (Korean Version Soundtrack) - Danielle as Ariel

summary.ja: 韓国語吹替版でアリエル役を務めたダニエルが「저곳으로」など4曲を歌う、全15曲の韓国語版サウンドトラック。
summary.en: The 15-track Korean-version soundtrack of The Little Mermaid, with Danielle, the Korean voice of Ariel, singing four songs.

detail.ja: ディズニー映画『リトル・マーメイド』の韓国語版サウンドトラックで、Walt Disney Recordsから配信された。全15曲のうち、ダニエルは「저곳으로（Part of Your World）」「저곳으로（リプライズ）」「처음으로（For the First Time）」「저 곳으로（リプライズII）」の4曲を歌っている。ほかに韓国語版キャストによる「신비한 바다 밑」「불쌍한 영혼」「입 맞춰」などと、Alan Menkenのスコア曲を収録。「저곳으로」は5月17日に先行配信されていた。
detail.en: The Korean-version soundtrack of Disney's The Little Mermaid, released by Walt Disney Records. Of its 15 tracks, Danielle sings four: 'Part of Your World' (저곳으로), its reprise, 'For the First Time' (처음으로) and 'Part of Your World (Reprise II)'. It also includes Korean-cast versions of 'Under the Sea', 'Poor Unfortunate Souls' and 'Kiss the Girl', alongside Alan Menken's score cues. 'Part of Your World' had been released ahead on May 17.

danielle_tracks.ja: パート・オブ・ユア・ワールド / パート・オブ・ユア・ワールド（リプライズ） / 何もかも初めて / パート・オブ・ユア・ワールド（リプライズ２）
danielle_tracks.en: Part of Your World / Part of Your World (Reprise) / For the First Time / Part of Your World (Reprise II)

editor_note: Melon album 11249055 「인어공주 (한국어 버전 사운드트랙)」 release date 2023.05.22, 15 tracks, Danielle credited on tracks 2/4/8/13. A 37-track deluxe edition (album 11251050) followed on 2023.05.26 with the same Danielle tracks; not added separately. Other Korean cast per Melon: Lee Jae-ho, Jung Sang-hoon, Jung Young-ju, Ra Jun et al. Release time not confirmed.

title.ja: Be Who You Are (Real Magic) - Jon Batiste feat. NewJeans, J.I.D, Camilo, Cat Burns
title.en: Be Who You Are (Real Magic) - Jon Batiste feat. NewJeans, J.I.D, Camilo, Cat Burns

summary.ja: Jon Batiste作のCoke Studio第2シーズン開幕曲。NewJeans、J.I.D、Camilo、Cat Burnsが参加したポップ／R&B。
summary.en: Jon Batiste's multilingual pop and R&B anthem opening the second season of Coke Studio, featuring NewJeans, J.I.D, Camilo and Cat Burns.

editor_note: Date 2023-05-31 from ja.wikipedia and en.wikipedia NewJeans article (unveiled May 31, 2023). | Confirmed 2023-05-31: Apple Music KR datePublished 2023-05-31; Melon album 11253115 date 2023.05.31. KST release time not found. | From coca-cola.com press release and udiscovermusic (31 May 2023); producer not named in sources.

detail.ja: コカ・コーラの音楽プラットフォームCoke Studioの第2シーズン開幕曲として発売されたコラボレーション曲。Jon Batisteが作詞作曲し、NewJeans、J.I.D、Camilo、Cat Burnsが参加した多言語のポップ／R&B曲で、Batisteがサビを歌う。同時公開のミュージックビデオはレコード店が舞台で、Batisteがかけたレコードにコカ・コーラの一滴が落ちると店内がアニメーションの世界に変わる。Coke Studioは2023年5月から9月までの展開で、デジタルハブは5月31日8時（米東部時間）に公開された。BatisteはVerve／Interscope所属。
detail.en: Collaboration track released as the opening anthem of the second season of Coca-Cola's music platform Coke Studio. Written by Jon Batiste, it brings NewJeans, J.I.D, Camilo and Cat Burns together on a multilingual pop and R&B song on which Batiste sings the chorus. The music video, released at the same time, is set in a record store: a drop of Coca-Cola lands on the record Batiste has put on and the shop turns into an animated world. The Coke Studio season runs from May to September 2023, and its digital hub went live on 31 May at 8:00 AM ET. Batiste is signed to Verve/Interscope.

credits.artists: Jon Batiste, NewJeans, J.I.D, Camilo, Cat Burns
credits.label: Verve / Interscope (Jon Batiste)

summary.ja: 「Zero」に米ラッパーJ.I.Dを迎え、ジャージークラブのリズムを合わせたグループ初のリミックス音源。
summary.en: The group's first remix release: 'Zero' reworked with a Jersey club rhythm and a rap feature from American rapper J.I.D.

editor_note: en.wikipedia gives June 20, 2023 (US time); ja.wikipedia gives 2023-06-21 (KST). Using 06-21. | Kept 2023-06-21 per Melon (album 11269317 date 2023.06.21) and Apple Music JP (2023-06-21). Apple Music KR/US page shows datePublished 2023-06-20 (US-date listing). KST time not found. | Credits and 18:00 KST time from namu.wiki Zero (J.I.D Remix); en.wikipedia gives 20 June (likely US date).

detail.ja: コカ・コーラ ゼロシュガーのキャンペーン曲「Zero」に米国のラッパーJ.I.Dを迎えたリミックスで、18時に配信された。収録時間は3分45秒で、作詞はGigi、Ylva Dimberg、J.I.D、作曲はMonro、Ylva Dimberg、J.I.D、編曲はMonro、Josh Cumbee、Christo。ポップとR&Bのコード進行にジャージークラブのリズムを合わせ、新たなアレンジとJ.I.Dのラップパートを加えたもので、グループとして初のリミックス音源になった。プロデューサーはMin Hee-jinとKeyon Kim。レーベルはADOR、流通はYG PLUS。
detail.en: Remix of the Coca-Cola Zero Sugar campaign song 'Zero' with American rapper J.I.D, released at 18:00 KST. Running time 3:45; lyrics by Gigi, Ylva Dimberg and J.I.D, music by Monro, Ylva Dimberg and J.I.D, arranged by Monro, Josh Cumbee and Christo. It sets pop and R&B chords against a Jersey club rhythm, adding a new arrangement and J.I.D's rap verses, and was the group's first remix release. Produced by Min Hee-jin and Keyon Kim. Released by ADOR, distributed by YG PLUS.

summary.ja: 『Get Up』の1曲目。放送25周年のパワーパフガールズとコラボし、MVではメンバーがアニメキャラクターに姿を変える。
summary.en: Opening track of Get Up, made with The Powerpuff Girls for the show's 25th anniversary; the video turns the members into animated characters.

editor_note: Confirmed: released 2023-07-07 13:00 KST with Super Shy (Apple Music KR "NewJeans 'Super Shy' - Single" datePublished 2023-07-07, 2 tracks). detail.en: Track 1 of the 2nd EP Get Up, pre-released together with 'Super Shy' (audio at 13:00 KST, music video at 00:00). Running time 1:48; Haerin is among the lyricists, and Park Jin-su (FRNK) and Frankie Scoca arranged and produced. The music video, directed by Youngeum Lee, was made with The Powerpuff Girls for the show's 25th anniversary and turns the members into Powerpuff-style animated characters.

detail.en: Pre-release single from the 2nd EP Get Up, released at 13:00 KST alongside 'New Jeans'. Running time 2:34; Danielle is among the lyricists, and Frankie Scoca arranged and produced. The track draws on liquid drum and bass and Jersey club, and the music video released with it was directed by Shin Hee-won and filmed in Lisbon, Portugal. The waacking-based choreography is by Black Q and Kim Eun-ju; a #ImSuperShy teaser had gone up on YouTube Shorts on 5 July.

detail.ja: 2nd EP『Get Up』の4曲目で、3つのタイトル曲の一つ。13時にEPとともに配信され、収録時間は2分27秒、作詞にはダニエルが加わり、UKガラージを基調とする。ミュージックビデオはside Aとside Bの2部構成で7月20日0時に公開され、Shin Woo-seokが監督し、スペイン・バルセロナで撮影された。エロスとプシュケの神話を下敷きにJung Ho-yeonがエロス、Micol Velaがプシュケ、Tony Leung Chiu-waiがアフロディテを演じ、side Bの終盤にはEPのインタールード曲「Get Up」が流れる。
detail.en: Track 4 of the 2nd EP Get Up and one of its three title tracks, released with the EP at 13:00 KST. Running time 2:27; Danielle is among the lyricists, and the track is rooted in UK garage. The two-part music video (side A and side B) was released on 20 July at 00:00 KST, directed by Shin Woo-seok and shot in Barcelona, Spain. Drawing on the myth of Eros and Psyche, it casts Jung Ho-yeon as Eros, Micol Vela as Psyche and Tony Leung Chiu-wai as Aphrodite, and the EP's interlude 'Get Up' plays at the end of side B.

detail.ja: 2nd EP『Get Up』の3曲目でタイトル曲。13時にEPとともに配信され、収録時間は2分31秒、編曲とプロデュースは250で、ボルチモア・クラブを基調とする。楽曲は7月1日と2日のファンミーティング『Bunnies Camp』で初披露されていた。同時公開のミュージックビデオはShin Woo-seokが監督し、Appleとの協業で全編iPhone 14 Proで撮影され、バルセロナを舞台に友人の恋人の浮気を確かめに行くという筋立てで、6月26日には16秒のティザーが公開されていた。
detail.en: Track 3 and title track of the 2nd EP Get Up, released with the EP at 13:00 KST. Running time 2:31; arranged and produced by 250, in the Baltimore club style. The song had been performed for the first time at the Bunnies Camp fan meeting on 1 and 2 July. The music video released at the same time, directed by Shin Woo-seok, was made in partnership with Apple and shot entirely on iPhone 14 Pro in Barcelona; the members set out to confirm that a friend's boyfriend is cheating. A 16-second teaser had been posted on 26 June.

Six tracks, 'New Jeans', 'Super Shy', 'ETA', 'Cool With You', 'Get Up' and 'ASAP', running 12:10 in total. 'New Jeans' and 'Super Shy' had been pre-released on 7 July. The physical release comes in three editions: Bunny Beach Bag ver. (six variants), The Powerpuff Girls X NJ Box ver. and Weverse Albums ver.

summary.en: OST Part 1 for the Netflix series A Time Called You, a remake of Kim Jong-seo's 1996 song and the first OST to feature all five members.

detail.ja: Netflixシリーズ『いつかの君に』（9月8日配信開始、監督Kim Jin-won、出演Ahn Hyo-seop、Jeon Yeo-been、Kang Hoon）のOST Part 1として18時に発売された。1996年のKim Jong-seoの同名曲のリメイクで、作詞はHan Kyung-hye、作曲はKim Jong-seo。収録時間は3分53秒。ギターを軸にした柔らかな音像にメンバーのボーカルを重ねた曲で、5人全員が参加する初のOSTになった。同日にSpecial MVも公開された。
detail.en: Released at 18:00 KST as OST Part 1 of the Netflix series A Time Called You (streaming from 8 September; directed by Kim Jin-won; starring Ahn Hyo-seop, Jeon Yeo-been and Kang Hoon). A remake of Kim Jong-seo's 1996 song of the same title, with lyrics by Han Kyung-hye and music by Kim Jong-seo. Running time 3:53. The members' vocals sit over a soft, guitar-led arrangement, and it is the first OST in which all five take part. A Special MV came out the same day.

credits.producer: Kim Jung-ha, Im Ga-won, Kim Min-ho

summary.ja: Riot Games制作のWorlds 2023公式アンセムで、NewJeansがボーカルを担当。MVは2022年王者Deftの歩みを描く。
summary.en: Riot Games' official Worlds 2023 anthem with NewJeans on vocals; the video traces 2022 champion Deft's road to the title.

editor_note: Premiered 14:00 KST 2023-10-04 (Oct 3 in US time). | Confirmed: Apple Music KR datePublished 2023-10-04; Melon album 11333953 date 2023.10.04; 14:00 KST per ADOR/Riot (newsis). Spotify has two "GODS" albums; 4uFXfeGmzFDUrYUyz3Wb1O is the alternate. | From esports.gg, lolesports.com and InvenGlobal coverage; MV director/animation studio not sourced. / Cut for length: release at 14:00 KST (3 Oct 10 PM PT) on YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music and other platforms; writers/producers Sebastien Najand and Alex Seaver (Mako) — retained in credits — and Seaver's earlier Worlds credits ('Legends Never Die', 'RISE').

detail.ja: Riot Gamesが制作した2023 League of Legends World Championship（韓国で10月10日から11月19日に開催）の公式アンセムで、NewJeansがボーカルを務めた。ミュージックビデオはLeague of LegendsのYouTubeチャンネルで公開され、2022年の世界王者Kim Hyuk-kyu（Deft）が高校時代にゲームと出会ってから2022年大会で優勝するまでを描く。K-POPアーティストがWorldsのアンセムを歌うのは初めてで、Riot Gamesと組んだガールズグループとしては(G)I-DLE、TWICEに続く3組目になった。
detail.en: Official anthem of the 2023 League of Legends World Championship (held in South Korea from 10 October to 19 November), produced by Riot Games with NewJeans on vocals. The music video, on the League of Legends YouTube channel, follows 2022 world champion Kim 'Deft' Hyuk-kyu from discovering the game in high school to his title run at Worlds 2022. NewJeans is the first K-pop act to sing a Worlds anthem and the third girl group to work with Riot Games, after (G)I-DLE and Twice.

summary.en: OST Part 1 for the SBS drama My Demon, released on premiere day: a remake of Kona's 1996 song arranged and produced by 250.

detail.ja: SBS金土ドラマ『マイ・デーモン』（11月24日22時初回放送、演出Kim Jang-han・Kwon Da-som、出演Kim You-jung、Song Kang）のOST Part 1として、初回放送日の18時に発売された。原曲は1996年4月20日にKonaがアルバム『Overlap』で発表した同名曲で、作詞作曲はBae Young-jun、今回の編曲とプロデュースは250が手がけた。収録時間は3分12秒で、インストゥルメンタルも同時収録された。ドラマOSTラインナップの第1弾で、発売元はGenie Music、企画はSBSコンテンツハブ、原盤はStudio S。
detail.en: Released at 18:00 KST on premiere day as OST Part 1 of the SBS Friday–Saturday drama My Demon (first episode 24 November at 22:00; directed by Kim Jang-han and Kwon Da-som; starring Kim You-jung and Song Kang). A remake of Kona's 1996 song of the same title from the album Overlap, written and composed by Bae Young-jun; this version was arranged and produced by 250. Running time 3:12, released with an instrumental version. The first entry in the drama's OST lineup, released by Genie Music, planned by SBS Contents Hub, with the master held by Studio S.

detail.ja: 初のリミックスアルバムで、18時に配信された。1st EP『New Jeans』とシングル『OMG』の6曲を250とFRNKがリミックスし、各インストを加えた全12曲、約42分35秒。「Ditto」「Attention」「Hype Boy」「Hurt」は250 Remix、タイトル曲「OMG」と「Cookie」はFRNK Remix。「OMG」のFRNK Remixはスレイベルの音で始まりヒップホップとアフロのリズムを用い、「Hurt」の250 Remixはブルーグラス風のアコースティック編成で、2022年12月28日公開のスペシャルビデオで先に披露されていた。
detail.en: First remix album, released digitally at 18:00 KST. Six songs from the 1st EP New Jeans and the single OMG were remixed by 250 and FRNK, with instrumentals added for 12 tracks and about 42:35. 'Ditto', 'Attention', 'Hype Boy' and 'Hurt' are 250 remixes; the title track 'OMG' and 'Cookie' are FRNK remixes. The FRNK remix of 'OMG' opens with sleigh bells and uses hip-hop and Afro rhythms, while the 250 remix of 'Hurt' is a bluegrass-style acoustic arrangement first previewed in a special video on 28 December 2022.

detail.en: IU's sixth EP The Winning was released on 20 February at 18:00 KST, with Hyein and former Rollercoaster vocalist Joe Won-sun featured on the track 'Shh..'. The track list had been revealed on 5 February, with the special narrator left undisclosed. IU wrote the lyrics for 'Shh..'.

detail.ja: シングル2集『How Sweet』のB面曲で、13時にシングルとともに配信された。収録時間は3分20秒で、作詞はGigi、Oscar Bell、Sophie Simmons、作曲は250、Oscar Bell、Sophie Simmons、編曲とプロデュースは250。ミュージックビデオは4月27日0時に先行公開されており、Youngeum Leeが監督、済州島の黄牛峙海岸などで撮影され、メンバーがシャボン玉やビーズのブレスレット、バルーンアートで夏の一日を過ごす。4月8日には日本のシャンプーのCMとフジテレビ番組のテーマソングとして約1分が先行公開されていた。
detail.en: B-side of the 2nd single album How Sweet, released with the single at 13:00 KST. Running time 3:20; lyrics by Gigi, Oscar Bell and Sophie Simmons, music by 250, Oscar Bell and Sophie Simmons, arranged and produced by 250. The music video had premiered on 27 April at 00:00 KST: directed by Youngeum Lee and shot on Jeju Island, including Hwangwuchi beach, it shows the members spending a summer day blowing bubbles, weaving bead bracelets and making balloon animals. About a minute of the song had been previewed on 8 April as the theme for a Japanese shampoo commercial and a Fuji TV programme.

summary.ja: 「How Sweet」「Bubble Gum」と各インストの4曲入りシングル2集。LPサイズのStandard ver.など2形態で発売。
summary.en: Second single album with 'How Sweet', 'Bubble Gum' and their instrumentals, issued as an LP-sized Standard ver. and a Weverse Albums ver.

editor_note: Confirmed: Apple Music KR "How Sweet - EP" datePublished 2024-05-24; Melon album 11475749 date 2024.05.24; 13:00 KST. youtube_music URL taken from MusicBrainz release page (not fetched directly). | From en.wikipedia How_Sweet and namu.wiki How Sweet. Retail listings also describe six Standard variants (group + five members) and Weverse A/B/C; not stated in Wikipedia, so omitted.

detail.ja: シングル2集で、13時に発売された。収録曲は「How Sweet」（3:39）、「Bubble Gum」（3:20）と各インストの4曲、計13分58秒。総括プロデューサーはMin Hee-jin、プロデューサーは250。3月27日にADORが「How Sweet」と「Bubble Gum」のダブルシングルを発表し、4月26日に予約販売が始まった。フィジカルはLPサイズのStandard ver.とWeverse Albums ver.で、CDのほかインタビューブック、フォトブック、ステッカー、ポスター、フォトカード、ポストカードが付属し、レーベルはADOR、流通はYG PLUS。
detail.en: 2nd single album, released at 13:00 KST. Four tracks, 'How Sweet' (3:39), 'Bubble Gum' (3:20) and their instrumentals, running 13:58 in total. Executive producer Min Hee-jin; producer 250. ADOR announced the double single 'How Sweet' and 'Bubble Gum' on 27 March, and pre-orders opened on 26 April. The physical editions are an LP-sized Standard ver. and a Weverse Albums ver.; alongside the CD they include an interview book, photo book, stickers, posters, photo cards and postcards. Released by ADOR, distributed by YG PLUS.

credits.label: ADOR
credits.tracklist: How Sweet (3:39) / Bubble Gum (3:20) / How Sweet (Inst.) / Bubble Gum (Inst.)

summary.ja: 日本デビューシングルのB面曲。日英韓で歌うドラムンベースで、村上隆と協業したアニメーションMVは6月17日に先行公開。
summary.en: B-side of the Japanese debut single: drum and bass sung in Japanese, English and Korean, with an animated video made with Takashi Murakami and released on 17 June.

detail.ja: 日本デビューシングル『Supernatural』のB面曲で、13時に配信された。収録時間は2分40秒で、Lolo Zouaïが作詞作曲とバックボーカルに参加し、編曲とプロデュースはFRNK（Park Jin-su）。日本語、英語、韓国語で歌われるドラムンベース曲。ミュージックビデオは6月17日0時に先行公開されており、Youngeum Leeが監督してTakashi Murakamiと協業したアニメーションで、ハニが映画の夜に誘った相手から花の絵文字だけが返ってきて、その意味をメンバーが読み解こうとする筋立て。ティザーは5月1日と6月10日に公開されていた。
detail.en: B-side of the Japanese debut single Supernatural, released at 13:00 KST. Running time 2:40; Lolo Zouaï co-wrote the song and sings background vocals, and FRNK (Park Jin-su) arranged and produced. A drum and bass track sung in Japanese, English and Korean. The music video had premiered on 17 June at 00:00 KST: directed by Youngeum Lee in collaboration with Takashi Murakami, the animated story has Hanni invite her crush to a movie night, get only a flower emoji in reply, and the group trying to decode what it means. Teasers had been posted on 1 May and 10 June.

summary.ja: 日本デビューシングルのタイトル曲。Pharrell Williamsが制作に加わったニュージャックスウィング調で、日英韓で歌う。
summary.en: Title track of the Japanese debut single, a new jack swing number co-written by Pharrell Williams and sung in Japanese, English and Korean.

editor_note: Removed 'also promoted in Korea' from the summary (Korean music-show promotion started in July 2024, after this date). | Confirmed: Apple Music KR datePublished 2024-06-21; Melon 2024.06.21; 13:00 KST (xportsnews). | Credits from en.wikipedia Supernatural_(NewJeans_song) and namu.wiki; Part.1 concept from Tenasia (2024-06-21). / Cut for length: full writer list (lyrics Gigi, Minji, Pharrell Williams, Ylva Dimberg; music 250, Pharrell Williams, Ylva Dimberg) — retained in credits.

detail.ja: 日本デビューシングルのタイトル曲で、13時に配信された。収録時間は3分11秒で、作詞作曲にPharrell Williams、作詞にミンジが加わり、編曲とプロデュースは250。ManamiとPharrell Williamsによる2009年の「Back of My Mind」を引用したニュージャックスウィング調で、日本語、英語、韓国語で歌われる。ミュージックビデオは2部構成で、Part.1は6月21日0時にDongle Shin監督で公開され、UFOなどの空想的なモチーフを交えながら、男子に恋するヘインの感情を軸に展開する。ティザーは6月15日と20日に公開されていた。
detail.en: Title track of the Japanese debut single, released at 13:00 KST. Running time 3:11; Pharrell Williams co-wrote the song, Minji is among the lyricists, and 250 arranged and produced. A new jack swing track that interpolates 'Back of My Mind' (2009) by Manami and Pharrell Williams, sung in Japanese, English and Korean. The music video comes in two parts: Part.1, directed by Dongle Shin, premiered on 21 June at 00:00 KST and follows Hyein's feelings for a boy amid dreamlike motifs such as a UFO. Teasers had been posted on 15 and 20 June.

credits.lyricist: Gigi, Minji, Pharrell Williams, Ylva Dimberg
credits.label: ADOR

summary.en: Japanese debut single: 'Supernatural', 'Right Now' and their instrumentals, in three editions with artwork by Takashi Murakami.

Oricon weekly singles: No.10 then No.4. | Confirmed: Apple Music JP "Supernatural - EP" datePublished 2024-06-21; Apple Music KR 2024-06-21; Melon album 11514014 date 2024.06.21; 13:00 KST. | Tracklist and producers from namu.wiki Supernatural(NewJeans); catalogue numbers from ja.wikipedia NewJeans and Joshin listing. detail.ja: 日本デビューシングルで、配信は13時に始まった。収録曲は「Supernatural」「Right Now」と各インストの4曲、計11分42秒。フィジカルはNJ x MURAKAMI Drawstring Bag ver.、NJ x MURAKAMI Cross Bag ver.、Weverse Albums ver.の3形態で、アートワークはTakashi Murakamiが手がけた。発売は3月27日にADORが2024年の活動計画として発表しており、6月26日と27日には東京ドームでファンミーティング『Bunnies Camp 2024 Tokyo Dome』が予定されていた。
detail.en: Japanese debut single, with streaming from 13:00 KST. Four tracks, 'Supernatural', 'Right Now' and their instrumentals, running 11:42 in total. Three physical editions, NJ x MURAKAMI Drawstring Bag ver., NJ x MURAKAMI Cross Bag ver. and Weverse Albums ver., with artwork by Takashi Murakami. ADOR had announced the release on 27 March as part of its 2024 plans, and the fan meeting Bunnies Camp 2024 Tokyo Dome was scheduled for 26 and 27 June.

title.ja: Pit Stop（未発表曲・NJZ名義でライブ初披露）
title.en: Pit Stop (unreleased, performed live as NJZ)

summary.ja: ComplexCon香港でNJZ名義で初披露された未発表曲。同じステージで、当面の活動休止が告げられた。
summary.en: Unreleased song first performed under the name NJZ at ComplexCon Hong Kong, on the same stage where the group announced a pause in activities.

editor_note: Not an official release. Performed two days after the 2025-03-21 court injunction barring independent activities; a Kbizoom lyrics page lists 'Released: March 24, 2025' but this is not corroborated. | Removed 'never officially released' (retrospective) from the summary. | Not a release: performed live at ComplexCon Hong Kong 2025-03-23 (bandwagon.asia, stereogum, GMA). No Apple Music / Spotify / Melon listing exists; no streaming links or cover art. Date left as event date; no primary source available. | Set details from Bandwagon Asia (2025-03-24) and Korea JoongAng Daily; attendance 'more than 11,000' per Bandwagon. / Cut for length: headline set of about one hour; snippets teased on social media in the preceding weeks; the statement was read in English and Korean; no production credits published. / 2026-10-23 nightly: Korea Times（2025-03-24）はAsiaWorld-Expo・「Pit Stop」・各自のソロ後に5人で披露を伝えるが、「NJZの名はステージで出ず、ファンがNJZと叫んだ」とし、発言者をミンジとヘインとする。GMA等はハニの発言を引用。detailの「LEDにNJZと表示」「ハニとダニエルが声明」と食い違うため要確認。公式の発表なし。

detail.ja: AsiaWorld-Expo ArenaのComplexCon Hong Kong「Complex Live!」でNJZ名義で初披露された未発表曲で、LEDにもNJZと表示された。各メンバーがソロカバー（ダニエルはTLC「No Scrubs」、ミンジはUPSAHL「Smile For The Camera」、ヘリンは「Dontcha」、ヘインはSWV「Use Your Heart」、ハニはGhost Town DJ's「My Boo」）を歌った後、5人でこの曲を披露した。最後にハニとダニエルが、3月21日のソウル中央地方法院の仮処分決定を尊重して当面の活動を休止すると述べた。音源は未発売。
detail.en: Unreleased song performed for the first time, under the name NJZ, at 'Complex Live!' during ComplexCon Hong Kong at the AsiaWorld-Expo Arena; the venue's LED screens displayed 'NJZ'. In the headline set each member first sang a solo cover (Danielle: TLC's 'No Scrubs'; Minji: UPSAHL's 'Smile For The Camera'; Haerin: 'Dontcha'; Hyein: SWV's 'Use Your Heart'; Hanni: Ghost Town DJ's 'My Boo') before all five performed the new song together. At the end of the set Hanni and Danielle read a statement that the group would pause all activities out of respect for the Seoul Central District Court's injunction of 21 March. No recording has been released.
